items.summary: @thatguybg: "first thing I built with Muse was tinder for unfollowing people on instagram. took 2 min. the native ig integration is sooooo useful"
items.prompt: Build me a swipe-style tool for unfollowing people on Instagram [criteria], using the native Instagram integration. Keep it simple and fast.

items.title: Super-sick dancing
items.summary: @dtrinh: "Superintelligence this, superintelligence that... How about super-sick dancing @Muse" : with a video of the agent showing off its moves.
items.prompt: Show me your moves: choreograph and perform a short dance for me.

items.title: Identify a place shown in a YouTube video
items.summary: @mcmar wanted to know the LA location Jaws was at from the Apple iPhone event. His Muse opened the YouTube video of it, scrubbed to the spot in the video, and correctly identified the place.
items.prompt: Watch this YouTube video [URL] and find the spot where [person] is at [describe scene]. Scrub to that moment and identify the location.

items.title: Find and book IMAX 70mm tickets with good seats
items.summary: @leoistheson's Muse agent found and booked his Odyssey IMAX 70mm ticket : with good seats : via the Stripe Link integration. Literally took under 5 minutes.
items.prompt: Find and book me [movie/event] tickets for [date]: [IMAX 70mm at theater], the best available seats. Use my saved payment via Link and confirm the booking.

items.title: Settle a debate with citations
items.summary: @PipeBladex asked his Muse to settle a debate with his girlfriend. It sided with her : with citations. Now he pays $20 a month to lose arguments faster and more accurately.
items.prompt: Settle this debate for us: [the debate]. Research it properly and give your verdict with citations.

items.title: Build a podcast, task tracker, and goal system
items.summary: @devang_shah's Muse runs a custom podcast he likes to listen to, plus a task tracker and reminders system : and tracks his long-term goals too.
items.prompt: Set up for me: a custom podcast about [topics], a task tracker with reminders for [tasks], and tracking for my long-term goal of [goal].

items.title: A weekly movie feed tuned to his taste
items.summary: He trained Muse on his movie and TV taste. Every week it checks what is playing in theaters and on the streaming services he has, and builds a feed of picks for him. He votes each pick up or down to tune it further, then opens the feed when he wants to watch something.
items.name: JJ Englert

items.title: A custom skill that books the movies from his feed
items.summary: His Muse agent runs on familiar agent commands like /subagents and /Compact, skills included. He had it build a skill that makes booking the movies from his weekly feed easier.
items.name: JJ Englert

items.title: A forklift driver's first 80 chats
items.summary: Three weeks in and 80 chats down. He drives a forklift in a factory and is not a coder. Muse ran blind playtests and a combat bug sweep on his AI dungeon master app and shipped the fixes, made 456 AI images for his D&D campaigns and a horror serial, and cut 37 videos.
items.name: Rob
